description.text: Discover this custom-built daylight ranch offering the perfect blend of comfort, style and nature. With 55ft of Washougal River frontage, you'll enjoy breathtaking views and a serene lifestyle just minutes from town. Main level living with spacious primary suite with large ensuite. Open concept kitchen flows seamlessly into dining and living areas with river views from nearly every window. Outdoor living at its best with sliding glass doors leading to large upper deck overlooking the large backyard & walkway to river. Daylight basement boasts expansive family room, 2 additional bedrooms and full bathroom. Brand new roof, interior & exterior paint, lower deck. Enjoy the beautiful surroundings and peaceful river lifestyle while close to town conveniences.

The open-concept main floor features durable laminate flooring, a cozy gas fireplace, and a light-filled great room that flows seamlessly. A sliding glass door opens to a private back patio off the dining room and into the expansive fenced yardperfect for entertaining, pets, or gardening.The kitchen is a standout, featuring stainless steel appliances, a gas range, granite countertops, a large pantry, and abundant cabinet space - ideal for home cooks and hosts alike. Upstairs, you'll find a versatile second-level family room/loft space, perfect for a media room, office, or playroom.The vaulted primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a generous walk-in closet and luxurious ensuite bath complete with tile floors, a double vanity with granite countertops, and a walk-in tile shower. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a convenient laundry room with tile floors and washer and dryer included complete the upper level.Additional highlights include a 2-car attached garage, gas forced air heating, and A/C. All appliances included make this a truly move-in ready home! Located close to local parks, schools, and shopping with easy access to SR-14 for commuting to Vancouver or Portland.Enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, space, and convenience in a well-established community. Dont miss this unique end-unit with room to grow inside and out!

Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, single-level country home nestled on a sprawling 2-acre lot, offering a perfect blend of comfort and tranquility. The property boasts a detached garage/shop complete with an unpermitted ADU/guest quarters above, ideal for visitors or multi-generational living. Step inside to discover a spacious living room adorned with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, perfect for warming up on those chilly days. Outside, the property shines with a massive wrap-around deck, perfect for outdoor gatherings, and a beautifully landscaped garden area with raised beds, an orchard with fruit-bearing trees, and a chicken coop for the farming enthusiast. With gorgeous mature trees, fenced areas for animals, and plenty of space for trail riding, this property is a rare find, offering a serene country lifestyle while being just minutes from the Mercantile, schools and recreation. Dont miss your chance to make this exceptional home your own!

Introducing a truly custom contemporary luxury masterpiece that redefines modern living in one of Washougal's most coveted neighborhoods. Upstairs, you'll find two beautifully designed suites, including the luxurious primary retreat featuring a spa inspired bath with a rainfall walk in shower, boutique style custom closet, and a striking transparent resin soaking tub that feels like a work of art. Just minutes from downtown Washougal and the new waterfront, this one-of-a-kind home offers peace, privacy, and convenience all in one. Your dream home awaits!
